headline: Review and discussion of a draft ordinance prohibiting automated license plate reader systems, including Flock cameras.
summary: The meeting includes a review and discussion of a draft ordinance prohibiting automated license plate reader systems. The agenda lists these systems as Flock cameras.
items: Review and discussion of a draft ordinance prohibiting automated license plate reader systems (Flock cameras)
